mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.4% is rising from 0.0% at start of 2022
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rise >0.3pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE at 5.0% and PAYEMS at 144747.0 (up from 144000 in Jan 2022)
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal resilient consumer demand that offsets inflation concerns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240 and HOUST rises by >0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 104.0 signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth, increasing corporate costs and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift from credit-driven to real demand, reducing financial sector risks and boosting equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS at 459821.0 (down from 460000 in Jan 2022) and HOUST at 1142.0 (up from 1100 in Jan 2022)
regime_hint: demand shift from credit to real
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS decline and HOUST rise does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-federal funds rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a CPIAUCSL value below 240.5 (indicating low inflation) signals disinflation, reducing recession risk and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL < 240.5.
